question: Should staff hide/quarantine the disputed `@kingaiwork/shieldcortex` listing, require a rename, or leave it unchanged after verifying the public impersonation evidence?
rationale: The requested outcome is a trust-and-safety decision about live marketplace content and namespace ownership, not a deterministic source-code fix.

options.title: Hide or quarantine
options.body: Temporarily remove the disputed listing from public/install surfaces while staff verifies the rights and impersonation claim.

options.title: Require rename
options.body: Keep the listing available only if the current owner renames it away from the claimed brand and removes confusing metadata/body content.

options.title: Leave unchanged
options.body: Decline the claim if staff determines the evidence does not establish ownership or impersonation under ClawHub policy.

recommendation.title: Hide or quarantine
recommendation.body: Temporarily remove the disputed listing from public/install surfaces while staff verifies the rights and impersonation claim.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS routes the security-sensitive namespace, moderation, publisher, and API trust surfaces to this team.
